name: security
description: Baseline application security review for local generated products.
guidelines: Treat all request fields and uploads as untrusted.
Check authorization at the mutation boundary.
Keep secrets in environment/config outside committed source.
Avoid exposing debug stack traces or development consoles on externally bound interfaces.
Apply CSRF protection to cookie-authenticated state-changing browser forms when appropriate.
definition_of_done: Generated Compose/source contains no embedded real secrets.
